# Eval Qwen3-8B CWM repo-level s123 — final epoch checkpoint
# Run on GPU 1 after training completes
set -e
cd /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier

CKPT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_repo_cwm_8b_s123"
FINAL_CKPT=$(ls -d ${CKPT_DIR}/checkpoint-* 2>/dev/null | sort -t'-' -k2 -n | tail -1)
if [ -z "$FINAL_CKPT" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: No checkpoint found in ${CKPT_DIR}"
    exit 1
fi
echo "Using checkpoint: $FINAL_CKPT"

OUTDIR="/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/qwen3_8b_cwm_repo_s123_eval"
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 /root/miniconda3/bin/python eval_repo_cwm.py \
    --checkpoint_dir "$FINAL_CKPT" \
    --model_name /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
    --split test \
    --device cuda:0 \
    --max_seq_length 4096 \
    --max_new_tokens 512 \
    --batch_size 1 \
    --output_dir "$OUTDIR"

echo "Eval complete. Results in $OUTDIR"
python3 -c "
import json
results = [json.loads(l) for l in open('${OUTDIR}/results_incremental.jsonl')]
total = len(results)
unparseable = sum(1 for r in results if r.get('unparseable', False))
correct = sum(1 for r in results if r.get('correct', False))
print(f'Total: {total}, Correct: {correct} ({100*correct/total:.2f}%), Unparseable: {unparseable} ({100*unparseable/total:.2f}%)')
if total > unparseable:
    print(f'Accuracy (excl unparseable): {100*correct/(total-unparseable):.2f}%')

# gen_text length validation
gen_lens = [len(r.get('gen_text', '')) for r in results]
avg_len = sum(gen_lens) / len(gen_lens)
print(f'gen_text avg length: {avg_len:.0f} chars (expect >100 for repo-level CWM)')
if avg_len < 100:
    print('WARNING: avg gen_text too short — model may not be generating full traces')

# unparseable detail: neither PASS nor FAIL
no_verdict = sum(1 for r in results if 'PASS' not in r.get('gen_text', '').upper() and 'FAIL' not in r.get('gen_text', '').upper())
print(f'No PASS/FAIL in gen_text: {no_verdict}/{total} ({100*no_verdict/total:.2f}%)')
"
